name: Établi
story: AI project scoping as a product: a guided interview that ends in an honest go/no-go, so non-technical teams can scope their own AI projects without hiring consultants.
wentAsFar: A method tested by hand with colleagues at Finary, a full brand system, a live landing page and a first engine tested on a real case.
learned: The engine worked, but the interview ran long and the AI lacked business context. Generic scoping isn't enough: it needs a vertical.
